samples.question: Follow the connected strand from the gold bead along the gold run. Begin in state L. At each of its four teeth, a narrow tooth means hold the current state and a wide tooth means switch L to R or R to L; record the state after every tooth. Then read each colored run from its bead: a spur on traversal-left means L and one on traversal-right means R. Which colored run shows the four recorded states? Answer red, green, or blue.
